title: 2027 BNY Summer Internship Program - Audit (Dublin)
description: **Job Description** **Audit Practice** Internal Audit is an independent function at BNY that helps the organization succeed by assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal control environment. Through a combination of risk assurance and advisory support, the team provides analyses, insights, and recommendations that promote effective risk management and control. Interns in Internal Audit receive targeted on-the-job training and work alongside experienced audit professionals to build technical knowledge, strengthen soft skills, and learn how audit drives impact across the organization. **What You Will Do** * Support audit work by reviewing processes, risks, and controls across different parts of BNY’s business and operations. * Help analyze information, document observations, and identify themes that may point to control gaps, inefficiencies, or opportunities to improve. * Contribute to audit testing, walkthroughs, and reporting that help teams understand how effectively processes and controls are working. * Partner with audit professionals and business stakeholders to gather information, ask thoughtful questions, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. * Gain exposure to how governance, risk management, and internal controls support a global financial services company. **Skills You Will Build** * Risk and control thinking * Analytical problem-solving and critical thinking * Business process analysis * Written communication and concise reporting * Professional skepticism and sound judgment * Collaboration and stakeholder communication * Attention to detail and documentation discipline **Impact you will have at BNY** * Help teams identify risks earlier and improve how key processes and controls operate. * Contribute to work that promotes accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across the organization. * Support insights and recommendations that help protect the firm and strengthen the control environment. * See how independent review and objective analysis create real value in a complex global business. **Why this could be a fit for you** This role is a great fit if you like asking smart questions, solving problems, connecting details to the bigger picture, and doing work that helps organizations operate more effectively and responsibly. **Summer Internship Program** The BNY Summer Internship Program offers high-potential students a dynamic 10-week experience designed to accelerate development, build professional networks, and provide meaningful exposure to one of the world's leading financial services institutions. Through a skills-driven talent model, interns gain insight into the capabilities, platforms, and functions that power BNY's global franchise while contributing to impactful business initiatives. From day one, interns are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: * Enterprise-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. * Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands-on experience, skill development, and real-world business impact. * Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. * Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. * Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long-term career success. * A premier early-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. **Program Eligibility** * Enrollment in a 3 or 4-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business-related and/or technology-related majors preferred * Graduating in Dec 2027 or Summer 2028 * On track to achieve a 2.1 or higher * Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying. **About Us** At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. **About The Team** At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn **Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards** * America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 * World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 * “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 **Our Benefits And Rewards** BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. title: 2027 Graduate - Industrial Designer - Bray (Ireland)

title: Clinical Research Nurse (CNM1)
description: **Post Title:** Clinical Research Nurse – CNM 1 **Post Grade:** CNM1 **Department:** Cancer Clinical Trials & Research Unit (Oncology & Haematology) **Post Status:** Specified Purpose (maternity leave contract) **Hours:** 37.5 hours per week (Normally 08.00 – 17.00 Monday to Friday – this role may require flexibility on occasion) **Salary:** Appointment will be made on CNM1 Grade (€57,780 - €68,046 LSI) at a point in line with Government pay policy. **Responsible to:** Consultant Oncologists/Haematologists, CCTU Medical Director & CCTU Programme Manager **Reports to:** Programme Manager, Cancer Clinical Trials & Research Unit **Professionally Accountable to:** Oncology/Haematology Directorate, An Bord Altranais **Location:** Beaumont Hospital **Closing Date:** 18/11/2026 at 10am. Please note the hospital reserves the right to close the competition early should a substantial number of applications be received & a panel may be formed for future vacancies. Interviews for this post will take place on November 25th. **Job Summary:** The Cancer Clinical Trials & Research Unit is based at Beaumont Hospital, Beaumont Road, Dublin 9. It is led by a Consultant Medical Oncologist (CCTU Lead) and managed on a day to day basis by the Programme Manager. The Clinical Research Nurse is required to manage, co-ordinate and implement various clinical research studies which will be conducted through the CCTU. The appointee will liaise with the relevant research team to provide trial protocol education and to ensure recruitment targets are met, informed consent is obtained and to ensure accurate data collection. **Background Information:** The CCTU is funded, in part, by grant funding from the Health Research Board (HRB). The mission of clinical research nurses in the CCTU is to support the practice and development of the cancer clinical research programme for Beaumont Hospital and its affiliated institutions across Dublin North East. Provide specialised nursing care to patients in clinical research and their families, knowledgeable management of the clinical research protocol, effective communication, and staff education, working within a team to achieve high standards in patient care and clinical outcomes. The team of Clinical Research Nurses, under the direction of the Programme Manager , work closely with Oncologists, Haematologists, Clinical Data Managers, Clinical Trial Pharmacists, Administrative Assistant, Data Clerk and the Multi-disciplinary Team. **Responsibilities** **Key Duties and Responsibilities:** **Professional:** * Maintain professional registration. * Undertake further education as appropriate to keep updated with changes within the field of Clinical Research. * Attend and participate in: In service and staff education, Staff conferences appropriate outside conferences and/or other professional development activities. * Act as an advocate for clinical trial participants. * Participate in internal and external working groups to develop and share evidence based / best practice, locally, nationally and internationally if required. * Act as an ambassador for the CCTU and for Clinical Research Nurses, taking opportunities to promote both areas and clinical research in general. Research: * Work within the standard operating procedures and research protocols associated with industry and academic clinical research activities in accordance to Good Clinical Practice. * Play a proactive role in driving on-going clinical research projects through participant recruitment, participant follow-ups, identifying problems early and regular feedback with Principal Investigator and research team. * Actively participate in the implementation of clinical investigations and trials. * Assist in ensuring the overall smooth running of clinical research in line with best practice, ICH-GCP and within the scope of the protocol. * To ensure participant confidentiality and dignity is assured and maintained at all times during a clinical trial/research project. * Liaise with other members of research team and assist with maintenance and upkeep of clinical research documentation, including: site files, case record forms, monitoring arrangements, data correction, data collection and data entry. * Complete (with the help of the sponsor company if necessary) all ethical and regulatory procedures (submissions, query resolution etc.) for the clinical trial studies you are assigned. * Liaise with Study monitors to assist with internal and external Quality Assurance and Audit. * Review proposed research protocols and provide input to site study feasibility reports (where necessary) * Attend investigator meetings as appropriate relative to studies assigned to you. * Ensure prompt management of all study related correspondence (in line with SOP’s) * Assist in the preparation of studies for Internal / Sponsor / HPRA audits as required. * Provide a high standard of nursing care within a multi-professional research team. * Ensure participant treatment is in accordance with clinical research protocols. * Screen participants to identify suitable study candidates * Ensure that participants are fully informed of all details pertaining to the clinical trial/research project prior to their recruitment. * Carry out other duties as appropriate to the post as may be assigned from time to time by the Programme Manager and/or Consultant Oncologist/Haematologist and/or CNM2. **Clinical Practice responsibilities will include:** * Provide nursing expertise and care to participants participating in a clinical trial. * Ensure participants have an understanding of their disease and the proposed research and standard treatment options. * Work with a Multidisciplinary Team in evaluating and treating clinical problems, as they arise in the research settings. * Be competent in phlebotomy procedures or be willing to train. * Adhere to nursing policies and procedures for Beaumont Hospital. * Ensure continuity of patient care by liaising with outside health care professionals and/or other institutions where necessary. * Where patients are referred for clinical trial participation from other hospitals, adequately communicate with referring institution in the management, care and follow up of referred patients. * Facilitate effective communication of complex study information with all relevant research personnel, including: medical, nursing, administrative and pharmacy staff **Quality Assurance:** * Assist in the future development and evolution of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), for use by all research staff in the CCTU. * Maintain clinical and administrative records and reporting arrangements. * Provide a high quality efficient and effective service, respecting the needs of each participant. * Provide feedback to Programme Manager and Medical lead in monitoring the service ensuring it reflects current needs and implement changes where required and agreed. * Promote effective teamwork, initiate and support management of change within the CCTU . * Ensure safe use of all CCTU equipment. **Education & Development:** * Participate in teaching programmes for CCTU staff and the broader clinical research team including informed consent, randomisation and specimen collection. * Recognise and use spontaneous and formal learning opportunities and share knowledge and experience with other staff. * Continue to maintain and develop personal and management skills by undertaking mandatory and other training as required. Other duties and responsibilities may be specified from time to time at the discretion of the management. Note: as the Oncology/ Haematology services across the Dublin North East region continues to expand and evolve, it is likely that flexibility in regard to the allocation of specific duties will be necessary. Accordingly, the list of duties detailed above is not intended to be exclusive or restrictive, duties may be added or withdrawn but any such alterations will take place after consultation with the appointee. The appointee will report to the CCTU Programme Manager. Flexibility with working hours may be required to suit the changing needs of the CCTU. **Qualifications** **Selection Criteria:** Selection criteria outline the qualifications, skills, knowledge and/or experience that the successful candidate would need to demonstrate for successful discharge of the responsibilities of the post. Applications will be assessed on the basis of how well candidates satisfy these criteria. **Qualifications:** **Mandatory:** * Are registered in the relevant division of the Register of Nurses & Midwives maintained by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (Bord Altranais agus Cnáimhseachais na hÉireann) or entitled to be so registered. * Have no less than 3 years post registration nursing experience some of which must have been in Oncology and/or Haematology and/or experience in Cancer Clinical Research. * Have excellent communication skills - requires attention to detail and meticulous record keeping. * Have the interpersonal skills required to integrate as part of a diverse research team and the ability to relate to a broad spectrum of research participants. * Knowledge of ICH GCP desirable but not essential (ICH GCP training will be provided) * Have proven clinical skills such as venopuncture, current IV policy, basic life support training and ability to provide safe and high-quality nursing care to a wide variety of research participants across different disease spectrums. * Ability to work within scope of practice in a confident and safe manner, ensuring professional accountability and adherence to hospital policies and protocol. * Ability to work independently, self-directed but also works well within a team and under supervision and direction. * Have good IT skills including Microsoft Office, email etc. **Desirable:** * Postgraduate course in oncology/haematology * Experience in the field of clinical trials of medicinal products or medical devices. * Experience in Oncology and/or Haematology * Experience in translational “bench to bedside” research * Certificate in Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP) **Informal Enquiries ONLY to:** Name: Keith Egan Title: Programme Manager, Cancer Clinical Trials & Research Unit Email address: keithegan2@beaumont.ie Telephone: (+353) 18092010 If an appointee has previously been employed in the Civil or Public Service and that appointee is entitled to or in receipt of a pension from the Civil or Public Service or where a Civil/ Public Service pension comes into payment during the appointee’s re-employment that pension will be subject to abatement in accordance with Section 52 of the Public Service Pensions (Single Scheme and other Provisions) Act 2012. Please note: In applying for this position you are acknowledging that you understand that the abatement provisions, where relevant, will apply. It is not envisaged that the employing Department/ Office/ Body will support an application for an abatement waiver in respect of appointments to this position. Please be aware that Beaumont Hospital will never ask candidates to pay money at any stage of the recruitment process. Any requests for payment, bank details, or financial information in connection with a job application should be treated as fraudulent. If you receive such a request claiming to be from Beaumont Hospital, please do not respond and report to the recruitment department immediately.

completion. * Customer and Stakeholder Support + Work closely with Senior Controllers to support the delivery of team objectives and key market activities. + Support engagement with market participants and stakeholders to monitor capacity and renewable project delivery progress. + Co-ordinate customer and stakeholder meetings, including follow-up actions and communications. * Auction Operations Support + Support the effective operation of business processes within the Capacity Market or RESS. + Contribute to process improvements, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, controls and customer service. + Maintain accurate records and documentation to support operational excellence. + Prepare documents and analysis for review and approval by Senior Controllers in line with agreed processes. * Governance, Compliance and Audit: + Support the team's contributions to internal and external audits, ensuring evidence and records are maintained to a high standard. + Assist with the co-ordination of consultations, modifications and governance activities relating to market and auction rules. + Ensure activities are carried out in accordance with established controls, procedures and compliance requirements. **About You** * You hold a third-level qualification in Business, IT, Finance or a related discipline, typically supported by 1–2 years’ relevant experience. * external stakeholders. * Excellent time management and co-ordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. * An effective communicator who can convey information and ideas clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. * Strong numeracy and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and present information accurately. * Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work. * Experience presenting information to groups and stakeholders. * Highly proficient in Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 applications. * A We are hiring across a number of levels, from experienced Java Engineers through to Senior, Lead and senior technical leadership positions. These opportunities will suit strong hands-on engineers who enjoy working on complex, high-performance and business-critical technology platforms. The environment is highly technical, collaborative and international, with engineers working across modern Java, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud/container technologies. **The opportunities** Depending on your experience and level, responsibilities may include: * Designing and developing scalable, resilient Java applications. * Working on distributed, multi-threaded and asynchronous systems. * Building and improving high-performance, business-critical platforms. * Contributing to architecture, engineering standards and technical design. * Working across development, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps and other technology teams. * Improving CI/CD, development tooling, testing and engineering processes. * For more senior hires, providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and helping shape wider engineering strategy. **What we're looking for** We are interested in speaking with Java engineers across different experience levels. Relevant experience could include: * Strong hands-on Java development. * Spring Boot and modern backend engineering. * Distributed systems and microservices. * Concurrency, multithreading and asynchronous applications. * JVM profiling, performance tuning and debugging. * Kafka or other event-driven/messaging technologies. * PostgreSQL or similar relational databases. * Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift or cloud-native environments. * CI/CD, automated testing and Agile delivery. Experience working with low-latency or high-performance systems, financial services technology, React/TypeScript, cloud platforms or complex enterprise environments would also be beneficial, but is not essential for every position. **Senior / Lead opportunities** For candidates targeting the more senior positions, we are particularly interested in people who can remain technically hands-on while also influencing architecture, engineering direction and technical standards. Experience mentoring senior engineers, solving complex technical challenges and working with senior stakeholders would be highly relevant. **What's On Offer** * Multiple permanent opportunities across different seniority levels. * Hybrid and flexible working. * Competitive salaries aligned to experience and seniority. * Strong benefits package. * Excellent scope for career progression and technical development. * Opportunity to work on significant technology initiatives within a large international environment. If you are an experienced Java Engineer considering your next move, whether at Developer, Senior, Lead or technical leadership level, please apply or contact Cpl for a confidential discussion. Candidates need to have a minimum stamp 1G/Stamp 4 as there will be some travel to the UK.

title: Junior Fund Accountant
description: **Ready to take your first step into fund accounting?** Whether you’re a recent graduate looking to launch your career or an early-career accounting professional ready for something new, this could be the opportunity for you! **About us:** At Opus Fund Services, we believe great work starts with great people. As a global provider of fund administration services, we support investment managers around the world with specialist expertise and tailored solutions. Joining Opus offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a specialist area of financial services, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to a global business. We value collaboration, fresh thinking and taking ownership, creating an environment where everyone can make a meaningful contribution. **Why join Opus?** Joining Opus offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a specialist area of financial services while contributing to a global business. Here’s what you can look forward to: * Join a recognised workplace and become part of a global team proud to have achieved the Great Place to Work certification in four countries. * Accelerate your development by learning from experienced fund accounting and financial services professionals, receiving on-the-job training, and building skills that will support your long-term career growth. * Work in a global environment, collaborating with colleagues across different locations within an internal financial services business. * Make a meaningful contribution by supporting the delivery of accurate financial information and meeting client requirements. **What will you be doing?** As part of our Fund Accounting team, you will support a range of accounting and financial accounting activities, including: * Assisting with the preparation and review of NAV calculations. * Preparing reconciliations, investigating discrepancies, and helping resolve exceptions. * Supporting the preparation of accounting record and client reports. * Processing and reviewing financial transactions to ensure accuracy and completeness. * Working with colleagues to meet reporting deadlines and deliver high-quality client service. * Developing an understanding of investment funds, financial products, and relevant accounting processes. **What are we looking for?** Whether you're a recent graduate or have gained some initial experience in accounting or finance, we'd love to hear from you! **About you:** * A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related discipline. * A recent graduate or someone with approximately 1-2 years’ experience in accountancy practice, audit, financial reporting, or a similar environment. * Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a good understanding of accounting principles. * An interest in financial markets, investment products, and the wider financial services industry. * Excellent attention to detail, organization skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities. * Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to learning, working with others, and using new technology. * Progress towards a professional accounting qualification, such as ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent would be advantageous. **Next steps:** If this sounds like you, then please hit ‘Apply’ now. We will ask you to upload your CV and complete a short application form.

title: Network Operations Center Engineer
description: **Based on site in Ballsbridge, early mornings and weekend work required** The Network Operations Engineer I is an entry-level technical role. Engineers I monitor, triage and maintain the health of Optical and IP networks in a 24x7 operational environment. This role is the first point of response for network alarms and incidents. It works closely with Network Operations Engineers II, who act as its escalation point, and with Team Leads to restore service and keep the network stable. The role is hands-on and follows defined procedures. Engineers I detect and acknowledge alarms, carry out first-level troubleshooting using established runbooks, open and document tickets, and support scheduled maintenance under guidance. Issues that go beyond first-level diagnosis are escalated promptly to Engineers II with clear initial findings. Engineers I build their skills through structured training, shadowing and mentorship. **Scope** * Serve as the first-level response point for optical and IP network alarms and incidents. * Monitor network health using NOC monitoring and alarm management tools, and acknowledge alarms within defined response times. * Perform first-level triage and troubleshooting following established runbooks and procedures. * Escalate incidents to Network Operations Engineers II with accurate initial diagnostics. * Create, update and maintain tickets with clear, accurate documentation. * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of senior engineers. * Develop technical knowledge of optical and IP technologies through training, shadowing and mentorship. **Roles and Responsibilities** **Monitoring, Incident Response & First-Level Troubleshooting** * Monitor optical and IP network alarms, events and performance dashboards across a 24x7 environment. * Acknowledge, prioritise and triage alarms and incidents according to severity and defined response times. * Perform first-level troubleshooting of optical (DWDM, CWDM) and IP (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP, OSPF) networks using runbooks. This includes checking optical power levels, interface status, alarm states, protocol adjacencies and basic connectivity. * Gather initial diagnostic information such as logs, alarm history, interface counters and recent changes to support fault isolation. * Escalate incidents that cannot be resolved at first level to Network Operations Engineers II, with clear findings and the steps already taken. * Support senior engineers during major service-impacting incidents by running checks, gathering data and keeping tickets updated. **Ticket & Case Management** * Create, update and close tickets with accurate, detailed and timely documentation for all work performed. * Open cases with vendor TACs (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera) when directed, and provide the requested logs and diagnostics. * Track open tickets and vendor cases, and follow up to ensure timely progress. * Verify basic service restoration after an incident and record the outcome in the ticket. * Notify internal stakeholders and customers of incidents using approved communication templates. **Maintenance & Change Support** * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of Engineers II or III, including pre- and post-change checks. * Follow approved method-of-procedure (MOP) documents and change management processes. * Assist with turn-up and testing of new circuits, services and network elements. * Coordinate with field technicians, colocation facilities, ISPs and service providers to arrange access, dispatches and testing. **Learning, Process & Collaboration** * Complete structured training and shadow senior engineers to build optical and IP troubleshooting skills. * Follow runbooks and procedures, and flag gaps or inaccuracies to senior engineers for update. * Contribute to knowledge-base articles under the review of senior engineers. * Participate in shift handoffs and produce clear, complete shift-turnover notes. * Work collaboratively with NOC colleagues, Engineering and other operational teams. **Required Qualifications & Skills** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT support, or a related technical role; internships or lab experience are considered. * Foundational knowledge of IP networking (TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing and switching concepts), with awareness of BGP, OSPF and MPLS. * Basic understanding of optical transport concepts (DWDM, CWDM, fiber types, optics, patch panels) and optical power levels. * Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow procedures accurately. * Good written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation. * Willingness to learn, take direction and escalate appropriately. * Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based operational environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate-level certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, Nokia NRS I, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent. * Exposure to multi-vendor network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera). * Basic familiarity with fiber testing tools (OTDR, power meters, light sources). * Experience with NOC monitoring, alarm management and ticketing platforms. * Awareness of ITIL-based incident and change management processes. * Interest in scripting or automation (e.g., Python). **Physical Demands & Work Environment** * Ability to perform office-related tasks, including prolonged sitting or standing. * Capability to move within an office environment and effectively use a computer. * Must have strong communication skills for effective collaboration and coordination. * Occasional repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers may be required. * Availability to work rotating shifts, including weekends, and holidays as required in a 24x7 environment.

description: **Description** Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you. Key job responsibilities * Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform. * Collaborate with Senior Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read-path caching, and backpressure under load. * Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment. * Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar. * Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high-throughput services reliable, and participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root-cause resolution. A day in the life You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production. **About The Team** Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future. **Basic Qualifications** * Experience (non-internship) in professional software development * Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** Security Business Enablement (SBE) is Stripe's commercial security function: the interface between Stripe's internal security program and its Go-to-Market organization. We make sure security and compliance requirements never block, delay, or devalue Stripe's deals. This work is about customer trust: businesses entrust Stripe with critical financial infrastructure, and their security teams need confidence that Stripe meets rigorous standards before, during, and after the sale. We make that trust tangible with accurate, consistent evidence of Stripe's security posture. We own security due diligence end to end: questionnaire response, compliance evidence, live security reviews, gap and exception management, contractual security exhibits, rapid response during industry-wide events, and executive briefings. We engage customers directly, up to CISO level, and equip sales teams to handle security conversations on their own. Our scope is unusually broad: one assessment can span security, privacy, business continuity, and resilience, translating deep control detail into language procurement, legal, and a CISO can each act on. We are often the first team asked to represent emerging parts of Stripe's posture. We work at the intersection of security, AI, and Go-to-Market. Our platform is built on authoritative grounding: answers are retrieved from a knowledge base we maintain and validate, not generated from first principles, so they are consistent and source-traceable. Our POC proved the concept and outgrew what agent builders alone can do; taking it to production quality is the engineering problem this role exists to solve. What you’ll do **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and scale an AI-powered platform that delivers validated answers to security questions on demand, for both the sales teams who ask them and the customers who need them, replacing inconsistent ad-hoc responses with consistent, source-traceable ones * Build the retrieval, content pipeline orchestration, and integration layers that off-the-shelf tooling cannot deliver, including support for multiple cloud environments and Stripe's full and growing product portfolio, so that answers stay accurate as Stripe's infrastructure and products evolve * Build automations that keep security content current as Stripe rapidly adopts new technologies and introduces new controls, including automated refresh and review cycles that route content to subject-matter experts and Legal for validation * Build the capability to manage industry-standard certifications and assessment frameworks, including the Shared Assessments SIG and the Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ * Build analytics and evaluation capabilities that measure and continuously improve the performance and coverage of the security content library * Extend the same platform and knowledge base to power a public and authenticated Trust Center, giving customers direct self-service access to Stripe's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance posture * Partner with security analysts and with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to expand coverage across Stripe's full security surface area, and own the reliability and operational health of what you build Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * 2+ years of software engineering experience building production systems * Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic) * Comfort working with retrieval-augmented architectures, content pipelines, and AI/LLM integrations, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly in these areas * Experience building workflow automation, including scheduled jobs, approval routing, and multi-stakeholder review processes * Comfortable instrumenting systems and working with data to measure quality, coverage, and performance, then using those measurements to drive improvement * Experience creating projects from scratch, taking ownership, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with non-engineering stakeholders (security analysts, sales teams, legal) * Seek out opportunities for impact and can execute in a complex, cross-functional environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-driven products or workflows, particularly retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems or knowledge management platforms * Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI systems, such as measuring retrieval quality, answer accuracy, or coverage gaps * Familiarity with cloud security concepts across AWS and/or Azure * Previous experience with security software engineering, compliance tooling, or GRC platforms * Familiarity with security assessment frameworks and standards such as the Shared Assessments SIG, Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001 * Experience with content management systems, structured content modeling, or documentation-as-code approaches * Experience building customer-facing or internal self-service tools at scale * Comfort working in a small team title: Technical Support Engineer (EMEA), Metronome
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** Metronome, now part of Stripe, is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code. Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic. What you’ll do As a member of our technical support engineering team, you will be on the front lines providing world-class customer service. As part of our engineering organization, you will become an expert on our product and partner closely with Metronome's engineers, customer success, solutions architecture, and growth teams, as well as our customers' developers. Your primary responsibilities will include handling customer escalations through our ticketing system, using internal observability tools to diagnose and scope customer-facing issues, collaborating directly with customers via Slack and other channels, and developing internal tools and documentation to improve the support experience. Since we view every support escalation as an opportunity to learn, both as individuals and as a company, you will play a critical role in providing feedback to our product team on common challenges and influencing our product roadmap. Through your interactions with individual customers, you will help improve our product for everyone. Your work will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers' success and the continued effectiveness of their integration with Metronome. **Responsibilities** * Provide technical guidance to customers’ developers on best practices for integrating with our APIs and utilizing our functionality. * Troubleshoot any issues that arise from customers and diagnose any blockers. Escalate issues with customer context to the engineering team. * Develop internal tools to automate customer workflows that are currently unavailable in our product. Provide feedback on recurring patterns and advocate for addressing feature gaps in the product. * Design and assist in implementing a comprehensive knowledge base to assist customers with using our product. Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * 2+ years of work experience in a B2B customer-facing technical support organization or in engineering * Experience working closely with engineering teams and providing technical feedback on customer issues * Ability to debug and triage bugs and escalations from customers * Can communicate technical capabilities of the product to customers * Experience writing scripts or internal tools using APIs, and functional knowledge of SQL * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts clearly * A mindset of customer empathy and ability to solve challenging problems **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience as an early or founding member of a support team, including building processes from scratch * Startup experience and familiarity with scaling a support team * Programming experience in one or more of Typescript, Python, or Ruby * You have worked on modern enterprise software which is business critical * Experience creating knowledge base articles and internal documentation * Familiarity with at least one ticketing system, such as Pylon, Zendesk, Front, or similar In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €76,800 - €115,200. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

title: NOC Engineer
description: Our client is a rapidly growing AI Hyperscaler at the forefront of next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure\*\*, building the high-performance computing and networking environments that power some of the world's most demanding artificial intelligence workloads. Operating in one of the fastest-growing areas of technology, the business is investing heavily in scalable infrastructure, advanced networking and cutting-edge technologies to support the increasing global demand for AI compute. This is an exciting opportunity to join a business helping shape the future of AI infrastructure, working alongside experienced engineers in a highly technical, fast-paced and innovative environment. As the company continues to scale its global infrastructure, it is looking for ambitious, technically curious individuals who want to develop their careers in network operations and gain exposure to large-scale optical and IP networking environments. The Opportunity We are looking for a Network Operations Engineer I to join a growing Network Operations Centre (NOC) team, supporting the reliability, performance and availability of critical optical and IP network infrastructure. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career network engineer or technically minded individual looking to build their expertise in a large-scale, mission-critical networking environment. Working within a 24/7 operations team, you will be responsible for monitoring network performance, responding to alarms, investigating incidents and carrying out first-line troubleshooting to help maintain network stability. You'll work closely with experienced Network Operations Engineers and Team Leads, gaining hands-on exposure to optical transport technologies, IP networking, multi-vendor equipment and industry-leading operational practices. The role offers structured training, mentorship and clear opportunities to develop your technical capabilities within the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure sector. Key Responsibilities Network Monitoring & Incident Management - Monitor the health, availability and performance of optical and IP networks within a 24/7 Network Operations Centre. - Identify, acknowledge and prioritise network alarms, events and incidents in line with established service levels and operational procedures. - Carry out first-line troubleshooting across optical technologies (DWDM, CWDM) and IP networks (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP and OSPF). - Perform initial diagnostic checks, including optical power levels, interface status, network connectivity, protocol adjacencies and alarm conditions. - Analyse network logs, performance data and recent changes to support fault identification and resolution. - Escalate complex technical issues to senior Network Operations Engineers, providing clear diagnostics and details of troubleshooting already completed. - Assist during major network incidents by gathering technical information, performing diagnostic checks and maintaining accurate incident records. Ticketing, Documentation & Communication - Create, manage and update incident tickets, ensuring all troubleshooting activities and resolutions are accurately documented. - Engage with equipment vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia and Infinera, to support technical investigations and fault resolution. - Track outstanding incidents and vendor support cases, ensuring appropriate follow-up and progression. - Verify network service restoration following incidents and document the outcomes. - Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams, stakeholders and customers using established communication processes. Network Maintenance & Change Support - Assist senior engineers with planned network maintenance, upgrades and infrastructure changes. - Carry out pre- and post-maintenance checks to help ensure network stability and service continuity. - Follow approved change management processes, technical procedures and Methods of Procedure (MOPs). - Support the provisioning, activation and testing of new network circuits, services and equipment. - Coordinate with field engineers, data centre and colocation providers, ISPs and external service partners to support troubleshooting and maintenance activities. ### Technical Development & Collaboration - Build practical knowledge of optical networking, IP routing and network operations through structured training and hands-on experience. - Work alongside experienced engineers to develop troubleshooting and incident management capabilities. - Contribute to technical documentation, operational procedures and internal knowledge resources. - Participate in shift handovers, ensuring clear communication of outstanding incidents, operational risks and ongoing activities. - Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure and wider technical teams to support a reliable and resilient network environment. - Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and network monitoring practices. ## What We're Looking For We're interested in individuals with a strong technical foundation, a genuine interest in networking and the motivation to develop within a fast-growing technology environment. \*\*Essential Skills & Experience\*\* - 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT infrastructure, technical support or a related field. Relevant internships, academic projects and hands-on lab experience will also be considered. - A degree or technical qualification in Networking, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. - Foundational understanding of IP networking, including TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, routing and switching. - Basic knowledge of routing protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF and MPLS. - An understanding of optical networking concepts, including DWDM, CWDM, fibre optics and optical power levels. - Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). - Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to technical troubleshooting. - Good communication skills and the ability to produce clear technical documentation. €55k
